name: title
label: Title
description: A meaningful title that best describes the contents of the embedded page

name: src
label: Source
description: The URL of the page to embed

name: width
label: Width
description: IFrame width in CSS units or numeric value representing pixels

name: height
label: Height
description: IFrame height in CSS units or numeric value representing pixels

name: allow
label: Allow
description: Specifies a Permission Policy for the iframe. The policy defines what features are available to the now-iframe

name: disableSandbox
label: Disable sandbox
description: Set to disable the following restrictions: allow-forms, allow-modals, allow-popups, allow-presentation, allow-same-origin, allow-scripts, allow-downloads. By default, only the allow-scripts restriction is removed

name: allowTopNavigation
label: Allow top navigation
description: Set when disableSandbox is true to enable allow-top-navigation. Warning: This property may produce unexpected page redirects with root relative iframe src URLs

name: data
label: Data
description: When 'data' property is changed now-iframe will call postMessage(data) on the native iframe element, the source document is responsible for handling the message

name: targetOrigin
label: Target origin
description: The targetOrigin must match exactly (including scheme, hostname, and port). If omitted, then defaults to the origin of the now-iframe host
